load.scheduling_note: Boundary scheduling may add a few iterations; report actual counts, not planned-minus-sent as dropped.
limits: Final latency includes DB polling; not exact commit time.
Pending, processing and lag are sampled sequentially and can overlap in-flight; do not sum as exact backlog.
CPU and write counters include observation; no uninstrumented control run.
DB/offset/Relay per-operation time is not measured in this workload; no causal bottleneck attribution.

relay.validation: requestId sets, one call per stage, zero failed/dropped, non-overlapping relay attempts, nonnegative residual checked
relay.scope: Successful relayOne wall times only. Empty polls/sleeps excluded. prepare contains peek/claim/lookup; do not add the grouped and component rows together. Producer.send includes KafkaTemplate work and Future.get, not broker-only commit time.
